layouts.description: Draft configuration: The full double hairpin configuration retains the outer northern curve, inner parallel return and southern spiral. The sharper northern alternative, shortened southern return and cross-facility shortcuts are excluded. Exact independent service-road nodes measure 1886.9 m against the catalogue distance of 1865 m. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1886.9 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
